comment: The panel prints pulsar and square over the two output jacks while the maker's tooltips call them Output and Trigger; the lines follow the panel, and square is the more accurate of the two names, because that jack carries a 50 per cent square wave at the pitch rather than a trigger pulse. The sync jack is read as a level every sample and not as an edge, so a gate held above 2.5V pins the oscillator at the start of its cycle for as long as it is held. FM INDEX is normalled to 1, so patching it with a cable at 0V removes linear FM rather than adding to it. The extended-range button carries no printed label. The sum ranges are written as the voltage the knob-plus-jack total is worth, since the clamp itself is on an internal ratio. The pitch figures are worked out from the code: the knob maps its travel onto MIDI note 23 to 49, or -12 to 84 with extended range on, and the frequency is 27.5 times two to the power of the note over twelve, clamped to 1Hz and 20000Hz. The only context menu is a light, dark and Halloween panel choice, which is cosmetic and gets no line. Commit 98d7049 is the only one carrying version 2.1.0-rev.0, its plugin.json is byte-identical to the installed one and its res/ matches the installed artwork file for file.
